about_the_game:
A Classical Journey with Misty!
Join Misty on his relaxing adventures across a nostalgic country side in Misty's Super Golf Solitaire. Blend strategy, luck, and breathtaking scenery in this fresh twist of a classic card game - Golf Solitaire.

What kind of game is it?

Misty's Super Golf Solitaire is a Golf Solitaire with deck-building elements.

Combine classic Golf Solitaire rules with special ability cards that you can buy to build a deck and clear more levels. Earn gold coins with each play. Play smart and do combos that will multiply the amount of gold you gain.  At the end of each round buy various cards with unique attributes such as wild cards, revivers, money bonus cards and scrap cards to help balance your deck. Each card has limited uses that shape your strategy. Every decision counts as you try to maintain your winning streak. Aim for the highest rank!

Classical Music and Landscapes:

Immerse yourself in Classical Music and landscapes inspired by the late 19th century and early 20th century that change with each level .
